source_text: Methods for calibrating noninvasive or implantable glucose analyzers utilize either alternative invasive glucose determinations or noninvasive glucose determinations for calibrating noninvasive or implantable glucose analyzers. Use of an alternative invasive or noninvasive glucose determination in the calibration allows minimization of errors due to sampling methodology, and spatial and temporal variation that are built into the calibration model. An additional method uses statistical correlations between noninvasive and alternative invasive glucose determinations and traditional invasive glucose determinations to adjust noninvasive or alternative invasive glucose concentrations to traditional invasive glucose concentrations. The methods provide a means for calibrating on the basis of glucose determinations that reflect the matrix observed and the variable measured by the analyzer more closely. A glucose analyzer couples an invasive fingerstick meter to a noninvasive glucose analyzer for calibration, validation, adaptation, and safety check of the calibration model embodied in the noninvasive analyzer.
target_text: 用于校准非侵入式或可植入的葡萄糖分析器的方法利用替代侵入式葡萄糖测定或非侵入式葡萄糖测定来校准非侵入式或可植入的葡萄糖分析器。在校准中使用替代侵入式或非侵入式葡萄糖测定允许将由于内建于校准模型中的采样方法，空间和时间变化造成的误差减至最低。另一方法使用非侵入式和替代侵入式葡萄糖测定与传统侵入式葡萄糖测定之间的统计相关性，来将非侵入式或替代侵入式葡萄糖浓度调整到传统侵入式葡萄糖浓度。所述方法提供了用于根据反应出分析器所观察的机体和所测量的变量的葡萄糖测定进行更为精确的校准的方法。葡萄糖分析器将非侵入式手指针刺测量计耦合到非侵入式葡萄糖分析器，用于嵌入于非侵入式分析器中的校准模型的校准、验证、适应和安全检查。

source_text: The present invention relates to a preparation process of DPP pigment which has the structure showed by compound II. The present invention has the main steps: firstly a reaction mixture which is compounded from tert-amyl alcohol sodium, compound III and compound IV is heated to refluxing, the refluxing state is kept for 4 to 10 hours, metal sodium is quenched by a water solution of methanol, cooled to the room temperature, filtered and dried, and as a result, coarse pigment is obtained. Then the coarse pigment which is obtained is poured in an organic solvent to refluxing for 3 to 18 hours, filtered and washed, and as a result, refined pigment is obtained. Finally, the refined pigment which is obtained, compound V and surfactant are mixed and poured in the organic solvent to refluxing for 1 to 12 hours, through filtering, washing with water, drying and crushing, and a destination product is obtained. Compared with the prior art of the preparation technology of similar DDP pigment, the present invention has the advantages that the coarse pigment yield and use safety stability and application performance of the finished products are enhanced.
target_text: 本发明所涉及一种具有式(2)所示结构的DPP颜料的制备方法，其主要步骤为：首先将由叔戊醇钠、式(3)和式(4)所示的化合物组成的反应混合物加热至回流，在回流状态下保持4～10小时，用甲醇水溶液将金属钠淬灭，冷却到室温，经过滤及干燥后得到粗品颜料；然后将制得的粗品颜料置于有机溶剂中回流3～18小时，经过滤及洗涤后得精制颜料；最后将制得的精制颜料、式(5)所示的化合物及表面活性剂混合后在有机溶剂中回流1～12小时，经过滤、水洗、干燥、粉碎得目标物。与现有制备同类DPP颜料技术相比，本发明的优点在于，提高了粗品颜料的收率及成品颜料的使用安全性和应用性能。

source_text: The present invention discloses a DNA microarray chip preparation method based on gel fixed nucleic acid. Acrylamide modified nucleic acid, acrylamide monomers, ammonium persulphate, propanetrioland water are mixed into prepolymers, wherein the concentration of the nucleic acid is between 0.001 and 100uM; the weight concentration of the acrylamide monomers is between 1 and 30%; the weight concentration of the ammonium persulphate is between 0.01 and 5%; the weight concentration of the propanetriolis between 10 and 50%; then, the prepolymers are spotted on a solid substrateby sample application; after the sample application, the spotted substrate is arranged in a closed box with tetramethylethylenediamine, so the tetramethylethylenediamine volatilized; the volatilized tetramethylethylenediamine is in array point contact with the prepolymer arranged on the solid substrate and has the polymerization reaction, so the nucleic acid arranged on each array point is fixed to the solid substrate through the copolymerization reaction. DNA microarray chips prepared by the present invention have the advantages of high evenness, high repeatability, high accuracy, high sensibility and improved hybridization efficiency.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种基于凝胶固定核酸的DNA微阵列芯片制备方法，将丙烯酰胺修饰的核酸、丙烯酰胺单体、过硫酸铵、丙三醇和水混合成预聚合物，其中，核酸的浓度在0.001-100uM之间，丙烯酰胺单体重量浓度在1-30%之间，过硫酸铵重量浓度在0.01-5%之间，丙三醇的重量浓度为10-50%，然后将预聚合物点样于固体基板上，点样完后将点样基片置于一放置有四甲基乙二胺的密闭盒中，使四甲基乙二胺挥发，挥发的四甲基乙二胺与固体基板上预聚合物阵点接触并使其发生聚合反应，使各阵点上的核酸通过共聚反应在固体基板上得到固定。由本发明制得的DNA微阵列芯片具有很好的均匀性、重复性和高的准确性和高的灵敏性，并能提高杂交效率。

source_text: The present invention relates to a muscle refining extract, a preparation method thereof and application thereof. The preparation method of the muscle refining extract comprises the following steps: pulverized muscles are dissolved in a physiological saline or phosphate buffer solution and centrifugated to obtain supernatant fluid; a filter membrane is degermed and centrifugally separated to obtain supernatant fluid; lower layer liquid is obtained by an ultrafiltration membrane; glucose gel chromatography is carried out, and the obtained chromatography eluent passes through the filter membrane and is degermed; the mixture passes through the ultrafiltration membrane to obtain the muscle refining extract. The obtained muscle refining extract has the actions for enhancing the neural stem cell activity, promoting the neural stem cell proliferation and replenishing reduced nerve fibers, and can be used for preparing medicine for treating and postponing nerve retrograde diseases, such as alzheimer's disease, etc.
target_text: 本发明涉及一类肌肉匀浆提取物及其制备方法与应用。所述肌肉匀浆提取物的制备方法包括：用生理盐水或磷酸盐缓冲液溶解经粉碎的肌肉，离心取上清液；滤膜除菌后，离心分离，取上清液；通过超滤膜取下层液；葡萄糖凝胶层析，得到的层析洗脱液经滤膜除菌；过超滤膜，得到肌肉匀浆提取物。得到的肌肉匀浆提取物具有提高神经干细胞活性，促进其增殖，补充减少的神经元的作用，可用于制备治疗与延缓阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病的药物。

source_text: The present invention relates to a rheumatism treating medicine composition, a preparation method thereof and application thereof. The rheumatism treating medicine composition is paste which is prepared from the following raw material components: 65 to 75 portions of water, 15 to 25 portions of milled rice, 5 to 15 portions of magnesium chloride, 5 to 15 portions of potassium chloride, 1 to 3 portions of Chinese wolfberry, 1 to 3 portions of cockroach, 1 to 3 portions of centipedes, 1 to 3 portions of earthworms and 1 to 3 portions of scorpion. The preparation method of the rheumatism treating medicine composition comprises the following steps: the water, the pulverized and sieved milled rice, the pulverized and sieved magnesium chloride and the pulverized and sieved potassium chloride are mixed; the mixture of the four materials is continuously preheated for 4 to 6 hours under the temperature of 40 to 60 DEG C; the preheated mixture is gradually heated to the temperature of 60 to 80 DEG C and is persistently heated for 4 to 6 hours to form a paste body; the paste body is cooled and is thoroughly mixed with the pulverized and sieved Chinese wolfberry, the pulverized and sieved cockroach, the pulverized and sieved centipedes, the pulverized and sieved earthworms and the pulverized and sieved scorpion, and then the rheumatism treating medicine composition is obtained. The present invention has no toxic and side effect on patients and also has the advantages of significant treating effect, short treating course, low treating expense and easy use.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种治疗风湿病的药物组合物及其制备方法和应用，是由包括以下原料组分制备而成的膏剂，水65-75、大米15-25、氯化镁5-15、氯化钾5-15、枸杞1-3、土鳖虫1-3、蜈蚣1-3、地龙1-3、全蝎1-3。将水、经粉碎过筛后的大米、氯化镁和氯化钾混合；将上述混合物在40-60℃下连续预热4-6小时；将上述预热的混合物逐渐加热至60-80℃，持续加热4-6小时，制成膏体；将上述膏体冷却，与经粉碎过筛后的枸杞、土鳖虫、蜈蚣、地龙、全蝎再充分混合，即得。本发明对患者无任何毒副作用，具有疗效显著、疗程短、治疗费用低、易于使用的优点。

source_text: The present invention relates to a soft PVC plastic for blood transfusion apparatuses, which is prepared from components of the following mass percent: polyvinyl chloride resin with the degree of polymerization of 1700 to 2500 as a plastic main body, 15% to 40% of phthalic acid, 15% to 40% of trimellitate and 5% to 30% of citrate as plasticizers, 5% to 10% of epoxy soybean oil and 1% to 2% of a composite calcium zinc stabilizer as stabilizers, and 0.1% to 0.5% of silicone oil as a lubricant. The present invention adopts a novel plasticizer system composed of the phthalic acid, the trimellitate and the citrate. The plasticizer system inhibits erythrocyte hemolysis, reduces the dissolved quantity of the trimellitate, and reduces toxicity. source_text: The present invention provides a potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method which relates to a method for saline water quality. The technical problem needing to be solved is to provide a method for improving potassium ion-unbalanced water quality into water for cultivation. The potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method comprises the steps of taking and preserving a water sample, detecting the water quality and adopting a water quality improving agent using potassium as a main component. The potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method is characterized in that the water sample is hermetically preserved at the normal temperature lower than 25 DEG C for not more than 48 hours; the unbalanced degree of potassium ions is detected by an atomic absorption spectrometry, the level of the unbalanced degree of the potassium ions is determined according to the percentage of potassium content accounting for total salt content in the water quality, and the water quality improving agent is adopted according to the level of the unbalanced degree of the potassium ions and the total salt content; the consumption (g/m3) of the water quality improving agent =[3.82*(the unbalanced level-1)-(the unbalanced level-4)/2]* the total salt content; the water quality improving agent is uniformly sprinkled in a water body after being dissolved by water, and then an oxygen enriching device is turned on for stirring. The potassium ion-unbalanced water quality improving method is suitable for improving the potassium ion-unbalanced water quality into the water for cultivation.

source_text: The invention provides an ultramicro semiconductor acceleration sensor with high sensitivity. source_text: The invention provides a method of precisely estimating the effective full-discharge capacity of a secondary battery. That effective full-discharge capacity degrades as the secondary battery is repeatedly charged and discharged. The method includes sequentially fully charging a reference secondary battery and fully discharging the reference secondary battery until the reference secondary battery is dead, n times, and simultaneously measuring (i) a constant-voltage period in which the voltage of the reference secondary battery is essentially constant each time the reference secondary battery is fully charged and (ii) full discharge capacity of the reference secondary battery each time the reference secondary battery is fully charged, and storing the constant-voltage periods and corresponding full-discharge capacities measured; and measuring the constant-voltage period each time a secondary battery, essentially identical to the reference secondary battery, is charged, searching the constant-voltage periods stored for the reference secondary battery for the full-discharge capacity corresponding to the constant-voltage period measured for the secondary battery, and setting, for the secondary battery, as an effective full-discharge capacity, the full-discharge capacity of the reference secondary battery stored and corresponding to the constant-voltage period of the secondary battery that has been measured.

source_text: The present invention relates to an electrochemical processing device and a method for organic wastewater by a three-phase activated carbon fluidized bed. source_text: The present invention provides a process for treating sewage and the mixed fluid of sewage and sludge, which comprises the following steps: first, a porous carrier pipe is coated with a layer of nonmetallic mineral particles or colloidal particles in a cross-flow microfiltration mode; then, sewage or the mixed fluid of sewage and sludge is filtered again in a cross-flow mode, the water quality of penetrating fluid can reach the standards of reuse water, and the flux of the penetrating fluid is large and stable. When the flux of the penetrating fluid is greatly decreased with filtration, tap water flows through a membrane pipe at high speed in a cross-flow mode so that the particle layer on the carrier membrane pipe and contaminants on the particle layer can be instantly washed away, and the treatment of sewage or the mixed fluid of sewage and sludge can be carried out again after a particle layer is recoated. The new process of the present invention can be used for the treatment of domestic sewage, landfill leachate, car washing wastewater and all kinds of industrial wastewater.

source_text: The present invention relates to a method for enhancing the thermal stability of a CoSi2 thin film and is used in the technical field of material preparation. In the present invention, an amorphous thin film with the ingredient of CoSi2 is prepared by cosputtering, the element of Zr is added in the thin film by cosputtering, the characteristic that zr is not dissolved in the CoSi2 thin film is used, and annealing is adopted to crystallize the amorphous thin film. After the amorphous thin film is crystallisated, the zr can be distributed on the periphery of crystal grains, and accordingly, the grain boundary diffusion is reduced; the thermal stability of the thin film is improved, and simultaneously, a part of the Zr form minute ZrSi2 and is dispersed and distributed on a grain boundary; the growth of the thin film grains and the formation of a caking phenomenon are hindered under the condition of annealing at the time of high temperatures. Accordingly, the thermal stability of the thin film is also improved. In the present invention, the thin film of 5%zr is added and is processed at the temperature of 850 DEG C, and the resistivity is 29 mu omega cm. The addition of the Zr improves the thermal stability of the thin film, and the resistivity of the thin film is only slightly improved.

source_text: The present invention relates to coating film agent type externally applied medicine for treating burns and scalds, and a preparation method thereof. The externally applied medicine contains the following components according to the proportion by weight: 100 to 180 portions of medicinal polyethylene alcohol, 0.5 to 10 portions of metronidazole and 2 to 20 portions of borneol. The preparation method has the following steps: the medicinal polyethylene alcohol is taken to be put in distilled water; then, the medicinal polyethylene alcohol is isolated from the water to be heated at the temperature of 70 to 80 DEG C till the polyethylene alcohol is dissolved; metronidazole powder is added into the polyethylene alcohol; the mixture is heated to be dissolved and is cooled to 20 to 80 DEG C; then, the mixture is filtered. The externally applied medicine can effectively prevent the bacterial infection of a wound surface for treating burns, scalds, etc. In addition, wound surface drainage is smooth, and no scar remains after cure. The externally applied medicine has the advantages of good therapeutic effect, simple preparation method and technological process and low cost.

source_text: A diagnosis method and apparatus for measuring blood hemoglobin concentration, oxygen saturation, pulse rate, respiration rate, or degree of aging of blood vessels using light includes an input/output unit for receiving a command for measurement from a user and for providing information on the result of a measurement to the user; a control unit for receiving the command for measurement from the input/output unit and for generating a control signal; a light generating unit for generating at least two light beams for measurement according to the control signal; a light receiving unit for receiving the light beams transmitted through an object that is subject to measurement and for converting the received light beams into electrical signals; and a data processing unit for processing the electrical signals received from the light receiving unit and for outputting information on the result of a predetermined measurement. Using such diagnose apparatus, blood hemoglobin concentration, oxygen saturation, pulse rate, respiration rate, or degree of aging of blood vessels can be measured with non-invading mode.

source_text: Disclosed is a water softening device which can produce soft water of various temperatures and facilitate the regeneration of an ion exchange resin thereof. The water softening device includes: a water softening tank in which an inner region containing therein an ion exchange resin is divided into a plurality of water softening regions respectively set to predetermined temperatures; a regeneration tank which is integrated with the water softening tank and contains a regeneration material of ion exchange resin; a cold/hot control valve for supplying raw water to a selected one of the plurality of water softening regions according to a temperature of the raw water so as to rapidly provide the softened water of a desired temperature to a user; and a regeneration valve for facilitating the regeneration of the periodic ion exchange resin by a simple manual operation.

source_text: The present invention relates to an abrasive-free polishing liquid for the chemical and mechanical polishing (CMP) of a phase change sulphur compound film material GeSbTe, and the application of the chemical and mechanical polishing liquid in the production of electronic device phase change memories. The abrasive-free CMP liquid contains an oxidant, a sequestrant, a pH regulating agent, a resist, a surface active agent, a defoaming agent, a bactericide, a solvent, etc. The polishing liquid has the advantages of less damage, easy cleaning, and no corrosion to devices or pollution to environment and is mainly used for the chemical and mechanical polishing of a key material GexSbyTe(1-x-y) for phase change memories. Redundant phase change film materials GexSbyTe(1-x-y) (wherein x is at least 0 and at most 0.5, y is at least 0 and at most 1.0, and x and y are not simultaneously equal to 0) are removed by using the polishing liquid via a chemical and mechanical polishing method to make a sodium electronic device phase change memory, and the method is easy and practical.

source_text: The present invention provides a novel gold base fiber composite material used for sliding contacts. The composite material comprises the components by the following weight percentage: 1 to 3 of Pd, 0.2 to 0.6 of Gd, 18.5 to 21 of Ni, and Au as the rest. The novel gold base fiber composite material is prepared by a laminated extrusion method, namely that the novel gold base fiber composite material is formed by that Au alloy belts and Ni belts are made into compound ingots by lamination, and the compound ingots are extruded. Compared with Au Ni system alloys, the novel gold base fiber composite material has the advantages that: (1) by adding Ni fiber reinforcement phases, not only is the mechanical property of the material effectively improved, but also good electric conductivity of an Au alloy basal body is maintained; (2) by controlling the diffusion layer and the organization structure of compound interfaces, the resistivity and the hardness of the material are further adjusted so that the material has a good comprehensive property; (3) the material has a high Ni content so that noble metals can be saved.

source_text: The present invention relates to a method for modifying nano calcium carbonate, particularly to a method for activating nano calcium carbonate emulsion. The method for modifying nano calcium carbonate of the present invention is characterized in that diphosphate which is a binary star surfactant is used as a modifying agent for coating and activating the nano calcium carbonate emulsion which is prepared by a carbonization method. Diphosphate which is a binary star surface modifier has the following molecule structure disclosed in the specification. The preparing method of the present invention comprises: the nano calcium carbonate is firstly prepared into emulsion; the temperature of the nano calcium carbonate emulsion is controlled to be from 50 to 100 DEG C; the pH value of the nano calcium carbonate emulsion is regulated to be from 6.0 to 7.5; the surface modifier is added to be stirred, and the temperature is kept within the range of 50 to 100 DEG C; reaction time is controlled to be from 15 to 60 minutes; finally, the treated hot nano calcium carbonate emulsion is filtered, and filtered liquid is discarded; a filtered cake is taken to be dried at 80 to 130 DEG C, pulverized and sieved to obtain the finished product of activity nano calcium carbonate.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种纳米碳酸钙的改性方法，具体说是纳米碳酸钙乳液的活化方法。本发明的一种纳米碳酸钙的改性方法，采用双子星表面活性剂二磷酸酯盐作为改性剂，对碳化法制备得到的纳米碳酸钙乳液进行包覆活化处理，所述的双子星表面改性剂二磷酸酯(盐)具有如下的分子结构：其制备方法如下：首先将纳米碳酸钙配成乳液；控制纳米碳酸钙乳液的温度在50℃-100℃，调节纳米碳酸钙乳液的pH值至6.0-7.5；加入上述的表面改性剂，搅拌并保持温度在50℃-100℃范围内；控制反应时间在15-60分钟。最后将经上述处理后的纳米碳酸钙乳液趁热过滤，弃去滤液，取滤饼在80-130℃下干燥，粉碎，过筛即得活性纳米碳酸钙成品。

source_text: The present invention relates to modified phenolic resin and a preparation method thereof. Phenol and p-toluene sulfonic acid are mixed according to the mass ratio of 1:0.0015 to 1:0.0020 and uniformly stirred, flax oil accounting for 45% to 55% of the mass of the phenol is added, and the temperature is raised to 135 to 145DEG C; heating is stopped after the reaction is carried out for 2 to 4h, and the reaction product is cooled to the room temperature during stirring to obtain a reactant of the flax oil and the phenol; the reactant of the flax oil and the phenol is heated and stirred, formaldehyde accounting for 84% to 88% of the quantity of the reaction substance of the flax oil and the phenol is added, ammonia water accounting for 3% to 5% of the quantity of the reaction substance of the flax oil and the phenol is added after uniform stirring, and the temperature is slowly raised to 100 to 115DEG C; the reactant is cooled when yellow turbidity occurs in the reactant, and vacuum dehydration is started until the temperature is 50DEG C more or less; when resin liquid becomes brown and transparent, dehydration is stopped, anhydrous alcohol is added, stirred, dissolved and cooled to the room temperature, and the material is discharged to obtain the modified phenolic resin. The crosslinked resin contains 35.7% of phenol, 17.9% of flax oil and 46.4% of formaldehyde according to the mass fraction. Analytical tests indicate that all the performance indexes of thermal stability, etc. of the modified phenolic resin are good.
target_text: 本发明中阐述了一种改性酚醛树脂及其制备方法，将苯酚、对甲基苯磺酸按1∶0.0015～1∶0.0020的质量比例混合搅拌均匀，并按苯酚质量的45%～55%加入亚麻油，升温到135-145℃，反应2-4h后，停止加热并在搅拌下冷却至室温，得亚麻油-苯酚反应物；将亚麻油-苯酚反应物加热搅拌，按照亚麻油-苯酚反应物质量的84%～88%加入甲醛，搅拌均匀后按照亚麻油-苯酚反应物质量的3%～5%加入氨水，缓慢升温到100-115℃，当反应物出现黄色浑浊时，进行冷却，直到50℃左右时开始真空脱水，当树脂液变成棕色透明时，停止脱水，加入无水乙醇搅拌溶解，冷却至室温出料，得改性酚醛树脂，按质量分率，交联树脂中含苯酚35.7%，亚麻油为17.9%，甲醛为46.4%，分析试验表明改性酚醛树脂的热稳定性等性能指标均较好。

source_text: The present invention relates to a method for continuously preparing bio-diesel fuel, which belongs to the field of the synthesis of biologic oil fuel. Short chain alcohol is used as an acyl receptor. Under the near-critical state, the critical state and the supercritical state of the short chain alcohol, reproducible vegetable oil fat is changed into bio-diesel fuel. A tubular preheater and a tubular reactor are heated to the set temperature. The short chain alcohol and the oil fat are continuously pumped into the tubular preheater according to a molar ratio by a high pressure pump, and are mixed. The mixture reacts for 10 to 40 minutes in the tubular reactor and is cooled. Then, the short chain alcohol and the oil fat are separated through a product separating tank. Therefore, the bio-diesel fuel can be continuously produced. As the present invention does not lead other impurities into a reaction system, pure glycerol products with high added value can be easily obtained through refining reacting byproducts of crude glycerol. The present invention has the advantages of no environment pollution, simple production process and separation process, low cost, high efficiency, large output, stable quality of products, etc. The technology of gradient temperature rising reaction is used to reduce the phenomenon of the cracking of unsaturated fatty acid chains at high temperature and improve the content of fatty acid ester in the products.
target_text: 一种连续制备生物柴油的方法，以短链醇为酰基受体，在短链醇的近临界、临界及超临界状态下，将可再生的植物油脂转化生成生物燃油，属于生物油料合成领域。将管式预热器、管式反应器加热至设定温度，利用高压泵分别将短链醇与油脂按摩尔比连续泵入管式预热器，混合，在管式反应器中反应10～40分钟，冷却，经产品分离罐分离，即可连续生产出生物柴油。本发明由于在反应体系中没有引进其他杂质，反应副产物粗甘油更容易通过精致获得高附加值的纯甘油产品；具有环境友好，生产分离过程简便，成本低，效率高，产量大，产品品质稳定等优点；采用的梯度升温反应工艺，大大降低了高温下不饱和脂肪酸链发生裂解现象，提高了产品中脂肪酸酯的含量。

source_text: The present invention relates to a fiber reinforced artificial stone tomb box and a manufacture method thereof, a box body and a box cover of which are made of fiber reinforced artificial stones, wherein the inner part of the box body has a hollow cavity, four edges of the box cover have downward convex fringes, and the inner edge of each downward convex fringe is engaged with the outer edge of the upper fringe of the box body. Firstly, raw material is mixed into slurry in a stirrer according to mixing proportions, and then, a fiber mesh fabric is laid in a mold according to the shape of a tomb box; next, the slurry is put into the mold, and finally, surface treating liquid is sprayed to obtain a finished product after the slurry is molded, maintained, stripped, repaired and trimmed. Proportions of the raw material comprise 35 parts to 60 parts of cement, 40 parts to 65 parts of fine aggregate, 1 part to 4 parts of fiber filaments, 1 part to 8 parts of anti-cracking permeability-reducing agent, 0.2 part to 1 part of super plasticizer, 1 part to 5 parts of silicate reinforcing agent, 0 part to 4 parts of surface treating liquid, 0 part to 0.5 part of defoaming agent and 0 part to 0.5 part of paint. The present invention not only overcomes the defects of low impact resistance performance, low permeability-reducing performance and scarce resources in traditional natural stone tomb boxes, but also has the advantages of high strength, high temperature resistance, no crack, good integrity and appearance, and low cost. The present invention is favorable for environmental protection.
target_text: 一种纤维增强人造石墓箱及其制作方法，其箱体和箱盖由纤维增强人造石制作，箱体内部有空腔，箱盖四边有下凸沿，下凸沿的内边与箱体上沿的外边吻合。先在搅拌器中将原料按配比混合成浆料，然后在模具内按墓箱形状铺纤维网布，再将上述浆料入模，经成型、养护、脱模、修补和修整，最后喷表面处理液出成品。原料配比：35-60份水泥、40-65份细集料、1-4份纤维丝、1-8份抗裂防渗剂、0.2-1份超塑化剂、1-5份硅酸盐增强剂、0-4份表面处理液、0-0.5份消泡剂、0-5颜料。既解决了传统天然石材墓箱抗冲击性与抗渗性差及资源稀缺性的问题，又具有高强、耐高温不开裂、整体性与外观性好、成本低的特点，有利于保护环境。

source_text: The present invention relates to an improved technology for preparing ceftriaxone sodium. In the technology, the reaction between 7-ACT and AE-active ester is carried out in a solvent under the action of amine as an intermediate reaction body with nitrogen protection; then benzothiazole as a cosolvent is added; a salt-forming agent is added to react for separation and crystallization. The mixed solvent is composed of halogenated hydrocarbons of alkane, ethyl acetate or acetone, alcohol solvents and water. The benzothiazole as the cosolvent is added when the stirring reaction of 7-ACT and AE-active ester is clarified; then the salt-forming agent is added; extraction, delamination and aseptic filtration are carried out; the non-soluble organic solvent of ceftriaxone sodium is added; crystallizing treatment is carried out when the solution is turbid; the non-soluble organic solvent of the ceftriaxone sodium is added to separate crystals; finally the finished products of the ceftriaxone sodium used for injection are obtained by post-treatment of conventional crystallization, washing and drying. The adoption of the mixed solvent realizes the preparation of the aseptic powder of the ceftriaxone sodium directly from 7-ACT by direct salt forming without coarse salts. The present invention has the advantages of low solvent consumption, small labor intensity, short production period, low production cost, high product yield, good quality and small damage of the solvent to operating personnel, and is suitable for industrial implement and application.

source_text: The present invention relates to a flame-retardant polyurethane aqueous dispersion in the technical field of chemical industry, and a preparing method thereof. The dispersion body comprises the following components by weight percentage: 14 to 53% of diisocyanate, 6 to 78% of flame-retardant polyatomic alcohol, 0 to 52.5% of non-flame-retardant polyatomic alcohol, 4 to 8% of compound, 1.5 to 5% of neutralizing agent and 1 to 18.5% of small molecule chain expending agent, wherein the compound has active hydrogen and can form a hydrophilic radical. The preparing method comprises the procedures that the diisocyanate, the flame-retardant polyatomic alcohol, the non-flame-retardant polyatomic alcohol and the compound which has the active hydrogen and can form the hydrophilic radical carry out prepolymerization reaction at first to obtain a prepolymer I; the hydrophilic radical is neutralized by the neutralizing agent to obtain a negative ion or a positive ion polyurethane prepolymer II of a -NCO group sealed end; and the prepolymer II is dispersed into deionized water, and a chain is expanded by the small molecule chain expending agent to obtain the flame-retardant polyurethane aqueous dispersion body. The present invention has the advantages that a chemical structure with a flame-retardant function is led on a polyurethane main chain by molecular design, the product has internal flame-retardant performance, and the application range of the polyurethane aqueous dispersion body is expanded.

source_text: The present invention discloses a method for comprehensively recovering polymetallic bullion ore of high sulphur, high carbon or high arsenic. source_text: The present invention discloses a device and a method for detecting the weak absorption of optical materials, which is designed on the basis of the principle of F-P interference. A vacuum layer or an air layer is clamped between two identical narrow-band pass high-reflecting film systems to be used as a resonant cavity; therefore, a super narrow-band pass filter with high quality factors is formed; by using the characteristic that the transmissivity at the band-pass position is particularly sensitive to the absorption of the resonant cavity, as long as a sample to be detected is put in the resonant cavity, weak absorption exists in the resonant cavity, which can cause the transmissivity to obviously change. The extinction coefficient of the optical materials to be detected can be calculated through the change of the transmissivity and a standard curve of the difference (delta T) of peak transmissivity drawn by commercial film design and calculation software Filmstar with the change of the extinction coefficient (kappa); therefore, the absorption coefficient of the optical materials is obtained.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种用于光学材料微弱吸收测量的设备及方法，该发明是基于F-P干涉原理进行设计的，即在两片完全相同的窄带通高反膜系之间夹一真空层或空气层作为谐振腔，构成一个品质因子非常高的超窄带通滤光片，利用带通位置处的透过率对谐振腔的吸收特别敏感的特性，只要将待测样品放在谐振腔内，谐振腔内会有微弱吸收，就会引起透过率发生明显的变化，通过透过率的变化及利用商用的膜系设计与计算软件Filmstar绘制的峰值透过率差值(ΔT)随消光系数(κ)变化的标准曲线，就可以推算出待测光学材料的消光系数，进而得出其吸收系数。

source_text: The present invention relates to a method for measuring cooking weight of a microwave oven, which comprises a stage for setting multiple reference voltage values, a stage for using a thermoscope to measure voltage with the temperature rise in an oven chamber after a power supply is switched on, a stage for detecting whether the voltage measured by the thermoscope reaches the first reference voltage value, a stage for detecting whether the voltage measured by the thermoscope reaches the second reference voltage value after the voltage reaches the first reference voltage value, and a stage for judging whether the consumed time from the sensing initial point of the first reference voltage value to sensing initial point the second reference voltage value belongs to the determined time range and determining the weight of cooked food in the oven chamber according to the judging result. source_text: The present invention relates to a selection method of a leaching bacterium of zinc sulfate ore. source_text: The present invention discloses a method and a device for producing catalyst grade super high purity Sb2O3. The production method of the present invention is characterized in that the compressed air of 0.1 to 0.8MPa is sprayed to the surface of antimony liquid from the top of an antimony oxide furnace, and one of the following two modes is used, wherein one mode comprises that each position of a reaction area of a furnace chamber is heated to more than 1100 DEG C in a mode that partial heat quantity is supplied by the indirect heating of an electrical heating element, and the center temperature of the reaction area is more than 1200 DEG C; the other mode comprises that the fume of the furnace chamber is led in a high-temperature gasifying reaction chamber so that Sb2O3 fume is rapidly heated to 1100 to 1600 DEG C; then, the high-temperature antimony trioxide fume is cooled by a quenching mixing device, and dust is collected by a cloth bag to obtain an Sb2O3 product. The used production device is the improved antimony oxide furnace. Compared with the publicly known plasma production method and the device thereod, the product produced by the present inveniton reduces energy consumption by more than 70%, has furnace yield of 6 to 15 t/d and reduces production cost by more than 30%. The present invention has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, easy control of technological parameters, stable and reliable product quality, etc.
target_text: 本发明公开了一种催化剂级超高纯三氧化二锑的生产方法及其装置，其生产方法是从锑白炉炉顶向锑液表面喷入0.1-0.8MPa的压缩空气，并采用下列二者其一：(1)通过电热元件间接加热补给部分热量的方式，使炉膛反应区域各处温度提高到1100℃以上，反应区域中央温度在1200℃以上；(2)将炉膛烟气导入一个高温气化反应室，使三氧化二锑烟气迅速升温至1100-1600℃；然后将高温三氧化二锑烟气经过骤冷混合装置冷却，布袋收尘得到三氧化二锑产品。所用生产装置为一种改进型锑白炉。同公知的等离子体生产方法及其装置比较，使用本发明生产的产品，能耗降低70%以上，炉产量可达6-15t/d，生产成本可降低30%以上，且具有操作简便，工艺参数易于控制、产品质量稳定可靠等优点。

source_text: The present invention relates to a method and a system for measuring the coercive field strength of ferroelectrics. The method is characterized in that according to that a direct proportion relationship exists between external force subjected to a polarized ferroelectric sample and obtained piezoelectric voltage when the external force is within a certain range, low frequency sinusoidal wave alternating force is applied to the polarized ferroelectric sample so that low frequency alternating piezoelectric voltage corresponding to the low frequency sinusoidal wave alternating force is generated from both ends of the ferroelectric sample. A DC high voltage electric field is applied to the ferroelectric sample. Then, the DC high voltage electric field is adjusted from a low degree to a high degree till the low frequency alternating piezoelectric voltage of the ferroelectric sample is zero. The degree of the DC high voltage electric field is the coercive field strength of the ferroelectric sample. The DC high voltage electric field is obtained by means that DC high voltage is divided by the thickness of the ferroelectric sample. The method is characterized in that the coercive field strength is directly obtained by measuring the variation of the piezoelectric voltage generated from the polarized ferroelectric sample under the action of adding a DC high voltage electric field when the polarized ferroelectric sample is subjected to the external force.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种铁电体矫顽场强度的测量方法及其系统，该方法根据当外力在一定范围内，极化过的铁电体样品所受到的外力与所得到的压电电压成正比的关系，在极化后的铁电体试样施加一个低频正弦波交变力，以在铁电体试样两端产生出与低频正弦波交变力相对应的低频交变压电电压；再在该铁电体试样上施加一个直流高压电场，从小到大调节直流高压电场直至铁电体样品的低频交变压电电压为零，该直流高压电场的大小就是铁电体样品的矫顽场强度；所述的直流高压电场由直流高压的电压除以铁电体试样的厚度得到。该方法通过测量极化过的铁电体试样受到外力作用时自身产生出的压电电压在附加直流高压电场作用下的变化来直接得到其矫顽场强度。

source_text: The present invention discloses a method for treating waste water from m-dinitrobenzene production, which belongs to the treatment field of nitrobenzene waste water. The present invention comprises the following main procedures: standing and filtering waste water from m-dinitrobenzene production after regulating the acidity and passing the waste water through an absorption tower filled with macroporous resin, stopping adsorption after reaching the first leakage point, carrying out desorption and regeneration by using solutions of sodium hydroxide as desorbing agents, passing the absorbed yielding water through the absorption tower filled with the macroporous resin again after regulating the acidity, stopping adsorption after reaching the second leakage point, carrying out desorption and regeneration by using solutions of sodium hydroxide as desorbing agents, passing the absorbed yielding water through the absorption tower filled with the macroporous resin again after regulating the acidity, and carrying out decolorization treatment on the waste water, and then the absorbed yielding water is colorless and transparent liquid. source_text: The present invention relates to a capacity fixed and loop closed cyclic gas analyzing method for a sulfur determiner. The present invention is characterized in that a pipeline communicated with a reaction furnace is provided with an electrolytic bath, a filter and gas chambers, which of the four and the reaction furnace form a closed circuit; a measuring and controlling unit is used for controlling the opening of gas valves and a gas pump arranged on the pipeline, and thereby, gas to be measured is circulated in the pipeline and the gas chambers; then, the gas of fixed capacity is pumped from the closed circuit, and the sulfur content of a test sample is measured by scale transformation. A device is that the inner part and the outer part of the reaction furnace are connected with a communicating pipe, and the communicating pipe is orderly connected with the two gas chambers, the gas valves, the filter, the electrolytic bath and the gas pump in series and enters the reaction furnace to form a closed circuit; the inlet end and the outlet end of the rear gas chamber are connected with a by-pass pipe which is provided with the two gas valves, and the gas pump is connected at the place between the two gas valves, is communicated with the reaction furnace, and is simultaneously connected with a waste gas treating device by another gas valve. The present invention makes the gas generated by the combustion of a test sample fully circulate, the concentration of the gas in the whole gas chambers and the pipeline is uniform, the testing accuracy is improved, and the sensitivity requirement of a sensor testing head is low.
target_text: 一种测定可燃物质含硫量的闭路循环气体分析方法，其特征在于在与反应炉相通的管路上设置电解池、过滤器、气室和气泵，与反应炉形成闭式回路，利用测控单元控制其管路上气阀和气泵的开启，使待测气体在管路和气室中循环，然后在闭路中抽取定容量的气体，通过比例换算测定试样中的硫含量。其装置是在反应炉内外接一连通管，依序与两气室、气阀和过滤器、电解池、气泵串接后进入反应炉内形成闭合回路；在后一气室进、出端接有一旁通管，该管上设两气阀，两气阀之间接有气泵，与反应炉连通，同时通过另一气阀与废气处理装置连接。本发明可使试样燃烧后的气体充分循环，整个气室和管路中气体浓度均匀，提高了测试的精确性，传感器侧头的敏感性要求低。

source_text: Provided is a chromium-free rust inhibitive paint for metals which is obtained by mixing a flaky zinc powder into a water reducible binder solution containing a water reducible resin emulsion and a water soluble silane coupling agent. A thin film of a silane compound having a hydrophobic group is added to particle surfaces of the flaky zinc powder, whereby the flaky metallic zinc powder exhibits water repellent property. When a surface treatment agent which contains an alkoxysilane oligomer as an essential component is applied to the paint film of a rust inhibitive paint for metals, this extends the time until red rusting occurs on painted metal products to not less than twice and prevents white rusting and black rusting for a long time. Rust inhibitive performance is further improved by blending a nano-sized powder of titanium dioxide, polyvinyl butyral, a silane coupling agent, etc., with the surface treatment agent.

source_text: The present invention relates to a transmitter for measuring gas concentration of sulfur hexafluoride and a measuring method thereof. The transmitter is provided with a supersonic wave detecting device, a single chip computer and an environmental parameter collection circuit, wherein the supersonic wave detecting device is provided with a waveform generator, an amplifying and isolating circuit, a sampling device, a reference device, an isolating and amplifying shaping circuit, a comparing and measuring filter, a frequency divider and a crystal vibration circuit; the environmental parameter collection circuit is provided with a temperature collection circuit. When the transmitter is used, an ultrasonic measurement signal measured by the supersonic wave detecting device and a temperature signal measured by the environmental parameter collection circuit are used as variables, and the gas concentration of sulfur hexafluoride is calculated by the single chip computer according to a corresponding program formula by using the variables. The transmitter of the present invention has the advantages of simple structure and safe use; the transmitter can be used for the real-time measurement of low-concentration sulfur hexafluoride in situ, and the precision is high.

source_text: The present invention relates to a single pipe sediment sampler without boundary disturbance, which structurally comprises a sampling pipe and a supporting device thereof, wherein the upper mouth part of the sampling pipe is provided with a valve device which is a ball valve device capable of opening or closing the pipe mouth under the action of hydrodynamic force, and the valve device is structurally composed of a valve cover and a ball valve in the valve cover; a sealing ring matched with the ball valve is installed in the valve cover in the upper pipe mouth position of the sampling pipe, the ball valve is movably arranged on the sealing ring to form a valve for closing the upper pipe mouth of the sampling pipe. source_text: The present invention relates to a biomacromolecule detection method based on multilayer colloidal crystals, which belongs to a simple convenience and high flux detection method used for the biomacromolecule detection in biological samples. In the biomolecule detection process, a multilayer colloidal crystal membrane is used as a flowing carrier for the biomacromolecule detection, and the biomacromolecule detection method has the steps that 1, the multilayer colloidal crystal membrane is prepared; 2, nucleic acid or protein probe molecules are fixed to the multilayer colloidal crystal membrane; 3, target molecules are hybridized; 4, the biomolecular types are recognized through determining reflectance spectrum bands of the multilayer colloidal crystal membrane by an optical fiber spectrograph, and then, the existence of the target molecules is determined according to fluorescence signals or the light absorption degree on the target molecules. The present invention has the advantages of high hybridization speed and low cost, and is a simple fast and high flux biological detection method.
target_text: 基于多层胶体晶体的生物大分子检测方法是用于生物样品中进行生物大分子检测的一种简单、方便的高通量检测的方法，生物分子检测的过程中，以多层胶体晶体膜作为流动载体的生物大分子检测方法如下：第一步，多层胶体晶体膜与的制备；第二步，核酸或蛋白探针分子在多层胶体晶体膜上的固定；第三步，目标分子的杂交；第四步，目标分子的识别：利用光纤光谱仪确定多层胶体晶体膜的反射谱带以此来识别生物分子的种类，然后根据目标分子上的荧光信号或光吸收度来确定目标分子的存在与否。本发明杂交速度快，成本低廉，是一种简单快速的高通量生物检测方法。

source_text: A method for removing phosphorus in wastewater, which comprises a first crystallization step of reacting, in a first crystallization vessel, a phosphorus-containing wastewater, calcium chloride and a recycled hydroxyapatite slurry recycled form a precipitation tank and crystallizing, while adjusting the pH of the reaction mixture by the use of a pH-adjusting agent, a second crystallization step of feeding the slurry formed in the first step to a second crystallization vessel, adding calcium chloride to the slurry, to carry out further reaction and crystallization at a pH higher than that in the first crystallization vessel and of 11 or lower, and a step of feeding the slurry formed in the second step to a precipitation tank, carrying out precipitation and separation, discharging a resultant supernatant to the outside of the system as a treated water, and recycling most of the resultant concentrated slurry as the above-mentioned hydroxyapatite slurry. The above method allows the removal of phosphorus in a waste water without the use of a coagulant and also the formation of a hydroxyapatite excellent in filtration and dewatering characteristics from a phosphorus-containing waste water.

source_text: The present invention relates to a biodegradable plastic sheet material produced by using reproducible resources (plant starch) and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials and the weight percentage by parts of the biodegradable plastic sheet material comprise 100 parts of biodegradable plastic master material, 0 to 100 parts of methyl polyolefin resin, o to 100 parts of ethide polyolefine resin, 0 to 100 parts of propyl polyolefine resin, 0 to 20 parts of color master material, 0 to 3 parts of a lubricating dispersal agent, 0 to 2 parts of degradation assistant and 3 to 15 parts of a moisture eliminating agent. The raw materials are uniformly mixed and then are manufactured into the sheet material in a moulding device. The present invention is manufactured by starch biodegradable material and has the advantages of high starch content, strong capacity for replacing nonrenewable resources by fast growing resources, good biodegradability, uniform plasticization of the sheet material and proper flexibility and hardness and is extremely perfect for plastic suction forming. The present invention greatly reduces the equipment investment for not being connected with and not using a melting pump or a single screw extruder when a double gas exhaust and double screw extruder with a large slenderness ratio is utilized to extrude and form the sheet material.

source_text: The present invention relates to a preparation method for complete alternating structural polycarbonate with high molecular weight, which belongs to the technical field of a high molecular material. The present invention provides a method for using a bi-component catalyst to selectively catalyze epoxyalkane and carbon dioxide to react in order to prepare polycarbonate with high molecular weight and high alternating structure at low pressure or medium pressure. The bi-component catalyst is composed of the chiral quadridentate schiff base metallic complex (R1)(R2)SalenMX of a main catalyst, and the salt of a cocatalyst R1R32YX1, wherein R1 and R2 represent-H, C1 to C6 alkyl, C1 to C6 alkoxyl,-Cl,-Br or-NO2; M represents trivalent metal positive ions; X represents univalent negative ions. R1 and R2 represent alkyl; Y represents elements of the fifth main family; X represents the univalent negative ions. The molar ratio of the cocatalyst to the main catalyst is from 0.2 to 5:1. The catalytic efficiency of the bi-component catalyst reaches 10<5> g of polymer per mol of catalyst. The molecular weight of a copolymer exceeds 30000, and the molecular weight distribution of the copolymer is less than 2. Alternating structures exceed 99%. The method has the advantages of mild reaction condition and simple and convenient operation. The used bi-component catalyst has the advantages of simple synthesis, low cost and high activity, and is suitable for industrialization application.

source_text: The present invention relates to a polymerase chain reaction method and application thereof. The present invention provides a method for carrying out PCR reaction at the ultra-low denaturation temperature. The denaturation temperature of an adopted mould plate in prior 2 or 3 circulations is from 93 to 98 DEG C, the denaturation temperature is from 60 to 87 DEG C in the subsequent circulation, and the denaturation temperature is much lower than the general denaturation temperature of 94 to 96DEGC. Experiments discover that the method can become into PCR which is generally applied and can control the specificity of the reaction by the selectivity of the mould plate at the ultra-low temperature. source_text: The present invention relates to a zinc containing cracking catalyst, preparation and application in the synthesis of single-walled carbon nanotubes. The catalyst comprises aluminum oxide and iron oxide by a molar ratio of 4: (0.2 to 1.0), and the molar number of zinc chloride accounts for 0.01% to 0.15% of the sum of the molar numbers of the aluminum oxide and the iron oxide. In the preparation method, the zinc chloride and chlorides or nitrates of iron and aluminum are prepared to be an aqueous solution according to the molar ratio of the composition of the catalyst; after stir and mixture, the aqueous solution is dried; after sintering decomposition at 300 to 400 DEG C and pulverization are carried out, the catalyst is obtained by multiple sintering at 500 to 800 DEG C. When the catalyst is used for synthesizing the single-walled carbon nanotubes, hydrogen gas is filled to carry out reduction at 400 to 600 DEG C. After heat insulation is carried out for 15 to 60 minutes at a cracking temperature of 750 to 820 DEG C. The single-walled carbon nanotubes are synthesized by filling paraffin gases of C1 to C3. The present invention has the characteristics that metal zinc is used as an alloy element in the catalyst, the corresponding compound is the zinc chloride, and the zinc chloride has a low melting point and is suitable to make constituents uniform in a melting method. The production technology of the single-walled carbon nanotubes can be stabilized by the catalyst, and the single-walled carbon nanotubes have the advantages of high quality and good diameter uniformity.

source_text: The present invention relates to an electric deionisation method and an apparatus for producing super pure water by a separation bed. The apparatus comprises an anode chamber, a cathode chamber and a plurality of four-chamber units, wherein the anode chamber is provided with an anode; the cathode chamber is provided with a cathode; each four-chamber unit is formed in a mode that a first desalination chamber, a hydrolytic dissociation chamber and a concentration chamber are orderly ranged from the cathode to the anode. An anion exchange membrane and a cation exchange membrane are respectively arranged among the chambers, and anion exchanger or cation exchanger is respectively filled in the chambers. A direct current power supply is connected outside the cathode and the anode, and pole water orderly flows across the anode chamber and the cathode chamber. Raw water orderly flows across the first desalination chamber and a second desalination chamber, and the raw water is electrically deionized to generate super pure water. The inlet liquid of the hydrolytic dissociation chamber is part of the super pure water. The inlet liquid of the concentration chamber is the outlet liquid of the hydrolytic dissociation chamber, and solution in the concentration chamber and the second desalination chamber countercurrent flows. Compared with the prior art using a mixing bed electric deionisation method to produce the super pure water, the present invention has the advantages that the subacidity anion impurities, such as silicon, boron, CO2, etc. in the super pure water can be removed efficiently, and simultaneously, the area of the ion exchange membranes is obviously reduced, and the investment is saved.

source_text: The present invention successfully establishes a highly efficient regeneration system generated by organs of a thick-walled pod acacia crassicarpa. source_text: The present invention discloses a technology for producing a high-precision glass and quartz capillary, which comprises the steps: raw materials for manufacturing the capillary is put into a feed inlet of a melting furnace and is processed inside the melting furnace; simultaneously, a metal wire is stretched into the feed inlet of the melting furnace by using a metal wire driving device and a metal wire positioning device, and is put into the melting furnace; a glass rod or a quartz rod which is processed by using the melting furnace is stretched, and the metal wire is wrapped inside the rod to move along with the rod; a product can be obtained after the metal wire is removed from the glass rod or the quartz rod which is obtained after stretched, etc. In the present invention, the metal wire positioning device and the metal wire driving device are added to a traditional device for producing the glass and quartz capillary by using hot melt stretching, and the high-precision glass and quartz capillary with an inner diameter within one millimeters can be produced; a porous capillary which has more than two inner holes in a shape of a rectangle, an oval, etc. can be produced, and the purpose that the produced capillary has high precision and well concentricity can be ensured.

source_text: The present invention relates to a synthesis technology of octreotide, particularly to a solid phase synthesis technology of octreotide. The solid phase synthesis technology of octreotide solves the technical problem that the existing coupling agents need racemization in a reduction and excision method. The present invention has the technical scheme that the solid phase synthesis technology of octreotide comprises the following synthesis technological steps: chloromethyl resin is used as a carrier; firstly, a sodium hydride solution and 2-hydroxymethyl-3, 4-dihydropyran react with the chloromethyl resin in acetic acid dimethylamide at room temperature to obtain 3, 4-dihydropyran hydroxymethyl resin (DHP HM Resin); then, under the action of p-toluene sulfonic acid pyridine salt, fluorenylmethyloxycarbonyl-(O-tert-butyl ether) threoninol (Fmoc-The (tBu)-ol) is coupled onto DHP HM Resin; according to a synthesis method of Fmoc/tBu solid phase polypeptide, amino acid is coupled onto the DHP HM Resin one by one; finally, a mixed solution of trifluoroacetic acid, water, benzoyl thioether and ethylene alcohol is used for cutting off peptide from the resin to obtain a coarse product which is then oxidized by an air oxidation method to form sulfur-sulfur bonds, and octreotide is obtained through the processes of HPLC preparation, purification and freezing. The synthesis technology of the present invention has the advantages of simplicity, easy operation and octreotide scale synthesis.

source_text: The present invention relates to a technology and equipment for extracting raw materials of traditional Chinese medicine. A condenser (11) and an oil-water separator (13) are connected to an extracting tank (14) through pipelines to form one circulating loop, and a circulation pump (7) is connected through a pipeline to form the other circulation loop. Raw materials of traditional Chinese medicine are contained in a basket (17) and loaded in the extracting tank, and solvent is added. The raw materials are heated by steam for extracting, and medicine liquid is pumped in the extracting tank once again by the circulation pump through the circulation loops for carrying out dynamic circulation extraction. Evaporated essential oil in the raw materials of traditional Chinese medicine is separated through the condenser and the oil-water separator, and the separated solvent is used as new solvent and a heat source, which flows back to the extracting tank through the circulation loops for a next turn of circulation. The previous steps are carried out synchronously for repeated circulation until extraction is finished. The traditional Chinese medicine basket with a gap is arranged in the extracting tank, and the top of the equipment is provided with a top cover which can be opened fully. The present invention has the advantages of high extraction rate, homogeneous extracting liquid, realization of closed and circulated operation of the medicine liquid and full-automatic control, which satisfies the requirement of GMP for medicine production.

source_text: A method and a line for the continuous production of ultra-thin hot-rolled strip from thin slabs obtained by a continuous casting process, comprising an auxiliary cooling system, pre-deformation by rough rolling of the thin slabs immediately after the continuous casting, induction heating to fix the temperature of the intermediate strip between a chosen 1000 and 1400 ℃, final rolling of the hot-rolled strip to a minimum thickness of 0.4mm by rolling in not more than six passes, while maintaining the hot-rolled strip coming out of the final stand of the finishing mill at a controlled temperature higher than 750 ℃. source_text: The present invention relates to a device for drying gas or steam, particularly to a drier used in a steam generator in a nuclear power station, or in a drum boiler in a heat power plant. The present invention comprises a separate space which is composed of a top plate, side sealing plates, a porous plate and a water collecting tank, wherein a corrugated plate assembly is arranged in the separate space, the corrugated plate subassembly which is arranged on supporting bars is formed by the arrangement of a plurality of corrugated plates, and a plurality of drainage hook plates are arranged on each of the corrugated plates in spot welding; the gaps among the drainage hook plates and the corrugated plates are drainage channels, and a distance piece is arranged between every two corrugated plates; the drainage channels are formed by both sides of the drainage hook plate and the corrugated plates respectively, and thereby, the corrugated plate became a double hook corrugated plate. The width of the drainage channel shrinks from the steam flow inlet of the corrugated plate to the steam flow outlet of the corrugated plate. The drier has the advantages of higher critical flow velocity of the steam, better separating effect and smaller size.
target_text: 本发明涉及将气体或蒸汽干燥的设备，具体涉及一种核电站蒸汽发生器中或火电站汽包锅炉中的干燥器。它包括由顶板、侧封板、多孔板和集水槽所构成的分离空间，分离空间内设有波形板组件，波形板组件放在支承条上，波形板组件由若干个波形板排列构成，每块波形板上点焊有若干个疏水钩板，疏水钩板与波形板之间的空隙为疏水沟，两块波形板之间设有定距块，所说的疏水钩板的两侧分别与波形板构成疏水沟，从而使波形板成为双钩波形板；从波形板的汽流入口到波形板的汽流出口，疏水沟的宽度逐渐减小。这种干燥器的蒸汽临界流速更高，分离效果更好，并且干燥器的体积更小。

source_text: The present invention discloses the novel purpose of astragalus saponin A, namely the novel application to the preparation of medicines, and actually relates to the application of astragalus saponin A to the perparation of a medicine for treating diabetic peripheral neuropathy. Experimental research of pharmacodynamics proves that bendazac lysine has very obvious functions of lowering blood sugar and glycosylated hemoglobin and promoting the secretion of insulin, and can increase the activity of sciatic nerve GSH-PX and inhibit the activity of COX-2. BDL has obvious antioxidation and antiinflammatory functions to a DPN rat. The astragalus saponin A has the functions of obviously reducing the content of AGES in nerves and sera, obviously reducing the activity of aldose reductase (AR), enhancing pain threshold and the Na<+>,-K<+>-ATP enzyme activity in the nervus peripheralis of a rat with diabetes, increasing the conduction velocity of motorius. If added with proper auxiliary materials, the astragalus saponin A can be prepared into an oral preparation to serve as a medicine for preventing and treating diabetic peripheral neuropathy.
target_text: 本发明公开了黄芪甲苷的新用途，即在制药中的新应用。实际上是涉及黄芪甲苷在制备治疗糖尿病周围神经病变药物中的应用。经药效学实验研究证明苄达赖氨酸具有非常显著的降低血糖和糖化血红蛋白以及促胰岛素分泌的作用，能增加坐骨神经GSH-PX的活力，抑制COX-2的活力，BDL对DPN大鼠有显著的抗氧化和抗炎作用；具有显著降低神经和血清中AGES的含量，还具有显著降低醛糖还原酶(AR)的活性，能提高痛阈，提高糖尿病大鼠外围神经内Na + -K + -ATP酶活性，增加运动神经传导速度等功能。在黄芪甲苷中加入适当辅料，可制成口服制剂，作为预防和治疗糖尿病周围神经病变的药物。

source_text: A method of increasing the bioavailability upon oral administration of a pharmacologically active target agent, particularly an antitumor or antineoplastic agent which exhibits poor or inconsistent oral bioavailability (e.g., paclitaxel, docetaxel or etoposide), comprises the oral co-administration to a mammalian patient of the target agent and an oral bioavailability-enhancing agent (e.g., cyclosporin A, cyclosporin D, cyclosporin F or ketoconazole). The enhancing agent may be administered orally from 0.5-24 hrs. prior to the oral administration of one or more doses of the target agent, substantially simultaneously with the target agent or both prior to and substantially simultaneously with the target agent. A method of treating mammalian patients suffering from diseases responsive to target agents with poor oral bioavailability, as well as oral dosage forms containing such target agents, combination oral dosage forms containing bioavailability-enhancing agents and target agents kits containing enhancing and target agent dosage forms and dosing information for the co-administration of the same are also disclosed.
target_text: 本发明公开了提高药学活性靶药剂口头施用的生物可利用率的方法，所说靶药剂特别是表现出很低或不一致的口服生物可利用率的抗肿瘤剂(例如，paclitaxel，docetaxel或依托泊苷)，该方法包括给哺乳动物患者口头共施用靶药剂和生物可利用率增强剂(例如，环孢菌素A，环孢菌素D，环孢菌素F或酮康唑)。增强剂可以在口头施用一剂或多剂靶药剂0.5—24小时之前施用，或者基本上和靶药剂同时施用，或者在施用靶药剂之前施用并且基本上和靶药剂同时施用。本发明也公开了治疗患有适于用具有很低的口服生物可利用率的靶药剂治疗之疾病的哺乳动物患者的方法，包含这样的靶药剂的口服剂型，包含生物可利用率增强剂的组合口服剂型以及包含增强剂和靶药剂剂型和这些药剂共施用的用药信息的靶药剂试剂盒。

source_text: The invention discloses a glass molding forming device, which comprises a lower sleeve with a first peripheral wall and a first inner hole, an upper sleeve with a second peripheral wall and a second inner hole, a lower die core sleeved with the first inner hole and provided with a first molding surface, and an upper die core sleeved with the second inner hole and capable of moving between a first position and a second position and provided with a second molding surface facing the first molding surface, wherein the first peripheral wall is provided with a first abutting surface, the second peripheral wall is provided with an inner peripheral surface and a second abutting surface facing the first abutting surface, the second inner hole is provided with a truncated cone section defined by a guide surface part of the inner peripheral surface, the aperture of the truncated cone section increases progressively towards the lower sleeve, and when the first abutting surface and the second abutting surface of the lower sleeve and the upper die core move to the second position, the second molding surface is provided with a second abutting surface, The guiding surface and the first molding surface cooperate to define a forming mold cavity for forming a glass lens from a glass material.

source_text: Disclosed is a lithium-nickel-cobalt-manganese composite oxide powder for positive electrode of lithium secondary battery which has high volumetric capacity, high safety, and excellent charge/discharge cycle durability. source_text: The present invention relates to a technological method for extracting aluminium silicon alloy from pulverized coal ash which comprises a great amount of aluminium and silicon elements. The present invention is characterized in that the present invention adopts an ore furnace to directly extract the aluminium silicon alloy from the pulverized coal ash. The extracting process comprises the following procedures: the pulverized coal ash, an additive agent, a reducing agent, a binding agent, etc. are metered and weighed, 10 tons of the pulverized coal ash, 1.8 tons of powdered coke and bitumite, 2.4 tons of alumyte and 0.7 ton of the binding agent are proportionally mixed and evenly stirred after metered and weighed to be rolled into high-strength pellets; after cured and dried, the pellets are placed in the ore furnace, smelted in the temperature of 1600 to 2200DEG C and discharged successively 4 hours later; a refining agent is added into a refining furnace, refined in the temperature of 1400 to 1800DEG C for 0.3 to 1 hour, and then, slag is removed by vacuum filtration, and ingots are cast. Al2O3 in raw materials has a content of greater than 20 to 60 percent, SiO2 has a content of greater than 20 to 60 percent, and the total content of the aluminium and the silicon in smelted finished ingots is greater than 70 percent.
target_text: 一种粉煤灰提取铝硅合金的工艺方法，在粉煤灰中含有大量的铝硅元素，其特征在于：采用矿热炉直接从粉煤灰中提取铝硅合金，提取过程：将粉煤灰、添加剂、还原剂、粘结剂等物料计量称重，粉煤灰10吨，焦炭粉和烟煤1.8吨，铝土矿2.4吨，粘结剂0.7吨计量称重后，按比例混合搅拌均匀，辊压成高强度的球团，经过养护干燥后，置于矿热炉中在1600℃-2200℃温度下熔炼，4小时以后陆续出炉，在精炼炉中加入精炼剂，经过0.3-1小时的精炼，温度为1400-1800℃，然后真空过滤除渣、铸锭，原料中的Al 2 O 3 含量在20%-60%以上，SiO 2 在20%-60%以上，熔炼后成品锭中的铝硅总含量大于70%。

source_text: The present invention relates to a preparation method of anion composite modified organosilicon emulsion having the functions of softening and shrink prevention, and the emulsion is mainly used for improving the functions of softness and shrink prevention of fabrics. The preparation method is characterized in that fatty alcohol as an anionic emulsifying agent and peregal as an epoxyethane additional product are adopted and compounded with alkylphenol polyoxyethylene as a nonionic emulsifying agent, composite emulsion is copolymerized and modified among a silane coupling agent (gamma-mercaptopropyl methyl dimethoxy silane), a coupling agent (gamma-aminopropyl triethoxy silane) and an organosilicon monomer by using sulfonic acid as a catalyst to obtain the modified emulsion, and a substituting group of the silane coupling agent and a substituting group of the coupling agent are different. The emulsion prepared by the present invention has a solid content of 21% to 23%, and the appearance of the emulsion is milky. The emulsion performs excellent functions of softening, shrink prevention, washability, relaxation and elasticity on protein fabrics.

source_text: An aqueous polyurethane dispersion and thermosetting compositions containing them. The aqueous polyurethane dispersion includes an aqueous medium with dispersed polyurethane-acrylate particles, which include the reaction product obtained by polymerizing a pre-emulsion formed from hydrophobic polymerizable ethylenically unsaturated monomers, a crosslinking monomer, and an active hydrogen-containing polyurethane acrylate prepolymer, which is a reaction product obtained by reacting a polyol, a polymerizable, ethylenically unsaturated monomer containing at least one hydroxyl group, a compound that includes an alkyl group having at least one hydroxyl group and optionally a carboxylic acid group, and a polyisocyanate. target_text: 本发明涉及水性聚氨酯分散体和含有它们的热固性组合物。该水性聚氨酯分散体包括具有分散的聚氨酯-丙烯酸酯颗粒的水性介质，该颗粒包括通过聚合由疏水性可聚合烯属不饱和单体、交联单体和含活性氢的聚氨酯丙烯酸酯预聚物形成的预制乳液而获得的反应产物，所述预聚物是通过让多元醇、含有至少一个羟基的烯属不饱和单体、含有具有至少一个羟基和任选的羧酸基团的烷基的化合物以及多异氰酸酯反应而获得的反应产物。该预聚物包括至少30wt%的在分子的一端具有至少一个末端烯属不饱和键和在相反端具有至少一个含活性氢的基团的聚氨酯丙烯酸酯预聚物；和至少10wt%的在分子的各端具有至少一个末端烯属不饱和键的预聚物。

source_text: The present invention relates to a medicine for treating psoriasis, particularly to a medicament for treating diseases of psoriasis, dermatitis, urticaria, etc. The present invention is developed to solve the problems of the existing medicament for treating the diseases of poor therapeutic effect and long treatment course. The present invention is prepared from following medicines: Rehmannia glutinosa Libosch, stir-baked Flos Sophorea, red peony root, Radix Paeoniae Alba, arnebia root, scrophularia, tree peony bark, rhubarb, safflower, psoralea fruit, milkvetch root, cassia twig, ledebouriella root, glycyrrhiza, honeysuckle flower, cotex dictamni, curcuma root, Chinese honeylocust spine, grassleaf sweetflag rhizome and rice bean. source_text: The present invention provides a system for preparing ethylene glycol by ethylene by using epoxy ethane, which relates to production technology of ethylene glycol. The system comprises an epoxy ethane reaction system, an epoxy ethane hydration reaction system, an ethylene glycol vaporization system and a vacuum dewatering system, wherein an epoxy ethane reactor is a tube array type fixed bed reactor; the pipe diameter of a reaction tube is from 40 to 50MM; the vaporization system comprises a multi-effect evaporator system in series and a heat exchanger with low-pressure steam as a heat source; a tube plate of a reboiler of the vaporization system is a steel plate in a double-face composite structure; a basic material layer is carbon steel; a tube side composite layer is Monel alloy; a shell side composite layer is stainless steel. In the vacuum dewatering system, a preheater is arranged in the front of a dewatering tower and heats material feeding solution, and thereby, the temperature of the material feeding solution reaches or is higher than the bubble point temperature. The present invention has the advantages of less equipment investment and small land occupation, and furthermore, the present invention effectively solves the problems of corrosion protection and coke formation of equipment. The present invention also has good economic effect and is particularly suitable for yield increase and additional extension of ethylene glycol production.
target_text: 本发明提供一种由乙烯经环氧乙烷制备乙二醇的系统，涉及乙二醇的生产工艺。该系统包括环氧乙烷反应系统、环氧乙烷水合反应系统、乙二醇蒸发系统和真空脱水系统。其中环氧乙烷反应器为列管式固定床反应器，其反应管的管径在40～50毫米。所述蒸发系统，包括串联的多效蒸发器系统和一个以低压蒸汽为热源的换热器；其中蒸发系统再沸器的管板为双面复合结构的钢板，基材层是碳钢，管侧复合层是蒙乃尔合金，壳侧复合层是不锈钢。所述真空脱水系统中，脱水塔前设置有预热器，加热进料溶液，使其温度达到或高于其泡点温度。本发明系统的设备投资少、占地省、有效解决设备的防腐和结焦问题，具有很好的经济效果，尤其适用于乙二醇生产的增产扩建。

source_text: The invention provides a system for polishing one or more layers of a multi-layer substrate that includes a first metal layer and a second layer comprising: i) a liquid carrier, ii) at least one oxidizing agent, iii) at least one polishing additive that increases the rate at which the system polishes at least one layer of the substrate, iv) at least one stopping compound with a polishing selectivity of the first metal layer:second layer of at least about 30:1, wherein the stopping compound is a cationically charged nitrogen containing compound selected from compounds comprising amines, imines, amides, imides, and mixtures thereof, and v) a polishing pad and/or an abrasive. The invention also provides a method of polishing a substrate comprising contacting a surface of a substrate with the system and polishing at least a portion of the substrate therewith. Moreover, the invention provides a method for polishing one or more layers of a multi-layer substrate that includes a first metal layer and a second layer comprising: a) contacting the first metal layer with the system, and b) polishing the first metal layer with the system until at least a portion of the first metal layer is removed from the substrate. Moreover, the present invention provides a composition for polishing one or more layers of a multi-layer substrate that includes a first metal layer and a second layer comprising: i) liquid carrier, ii) at least one oxidizing agent, iii) at least one polishing additive that increases the rate at which the system polishes at least one layer of the substrate, iv) at least one stopping compound with a polishing selectivity of the first metal layer:second layer of at least about 30:1, wherein the stopping compound is a cationically charged nitrogen containing compound selected from compounds comprising amines, imines, amides, imides, and mixtures thereof, to be used with (v) a polishing pad and/or an abrasive.

source_text: The present invention relates to a preparation method for sodium sulfocarbonate, and the sodium sulfocarbonate is prepared by direct reactions of sodium sulfide and carbon disulfide. The present invention comprises the following steps: a, a sodium sulfide solution is added in a non-metallic atmospheric pressure reaction container, a proper amount of ethanol having the function of material transfer is added subsequently; b, equivalent or excess carbon disulfide is dissolved in the sodium sulfide solution; c, the reaction container is heated by microwaves, and the temperature of the solution in the container is kept between 20 DEG C to 45 DEG C; d, after reactions end, condensing water is turned on. Transfer and filtration are carried out, and the solution is stilly placed to be separated; e, the solution is crystallized and purified at low temperature to obtain sodium sulfocarbonate crystals. Since the present invention does not need pressure resisting containers necessary in the existing preparation methods, a microwave heating method not used in the prior art is used. Therefore, the present invention has the advantages of simple and convenient operation and convenient observation and control, reaction time is greatly reduced and is reduced to 5 min to 20 min from the existing 2h to 7h, and the purity of the obtained sodium sulfocarbonate is high.
target_text: 一种全硫碳酸钠的制备方法。该全硫碳酸钠是通过硫化钠与二硫化碳的直接反应制备而成。本发明包括以下步骤：a.将硫化钠溶液盛入非金属的常压反应容器中，接着加入起物质转移作用的适量乙醇；b.向硫化钠溶液内溶入等量或过量二硫化碳；c.用微波对反应容器加热，并把容器内溶液的温度控制在20℃～45℃之间；d.反应结束后，开启冷凝水，然后，转移、过滤、静置分液；e.低温结晶纯化、得到全硫碳酸钠晶体。由于本发明不需要现有制备方法中所必需的耐压容器；采用现有技术中没有采用过的微波加热方式。因此，其操作简便易行，观察与控制方便；反应时间极大地缩短了，由现有的2h～7h降低到5min～20min；得到的全硫碳酸钠纯度高。

source_text: The present invention relates to a preparation method of an anion composite modified organosilicon emulsion having the functions of softening, smoothening and elasticity. The emulsion is mainly used for improving the functions of softness, smoothness and elasticity of fabrics. The preparation method is characterized in that fatty alcohol as an anionic emulsifying agent and peregal O25 as an epoxyethane additional product are adopted and compounded with alkylphenol polyoxyethylene as a nonionic emulsifying agent, composite emulsion is copolymerized and modified among a silane coupling agent (N-(beta-aminoethyl)-gamma-aminopropyl methyl dimethoxy silane), a coupling agent (gamma-mercaptopropyl methyl dimethoxy silane) and an organosilicon monomer by using sulfonic acid as a catalyst to obtain the modified emulsion, and a substituting group of the silane coupling agent and a substituting group of the coupling agent are different. The emulsion prepared by the present invention has a solid content of 21% to 23%, and the appearance of the emulsion is milky. The emulsion performs excellent functions of softening, shrink prevention, washability and elasticity on protein fabrics.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种有柔软爽滑松弹功能的阴离子复合改性有机硅乳液的制备方法，主要用于提高织物的柔软、爽滑、松弹功能。其特点是它是采用阴离子乳化剂脂肪醇与环氧乙烷加成物平平加O 25 ，与非离子乳化剂烷基酚聚氧乙烯醚复配，磺酸为催化剂，将两种不同取代基的硅烷偶联剂N-(β-氨乙基)-γ-氨丙基甲基二甲氧基硅烷、偶联剂γ-巯丙基甲基二甲氧基硅烷与有机硅单体进行复合乳液共聚改性，制得了改性乳液。本发明制备的乳液，其固含量为21%～23%，外观乳白色。该乳液对蛋白质织物具有极好的柔软、防缩、耐洗、松弹功能。

source_text: The present invention relates to a composite microporous polysulphone filtering film as a nanometer antibacterial material and a preparation method thereof. The microporous filtering film is composed of polysulphone dissolved in a selected solvent and a mixed nanometer antibacterial material, wherein an additive is added to the mixture. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing mixed film casting liquid composed of the polysulphone, the solvent, the additive and the nanometer antibacterial material; standing deaeration and filtration for removing impurities; knifing by a wet/dry phase converting method, and forming a film by dipping the mixture in coagulating bath; soaking the film in pure water. The composite microporous polysulphone filtering film as the nanometer antibacterial material prepared by the method has the function of sterilization and disinfection at the time of filtering the film, and is capable of preventing he pollution of a film surface at the same time. Thus, the composite microporous polysulphone filtering film can be applied to film separation devices for producing pharmaceutical water and purifying drinking water under the three-defense condition of military. The composite microporous polysulphone filtering film has the advantages that the pellicle growth of the film surface is avoided, the biological pollution of produced water is controlled, and the quality of the produced water is improved.
target_text: 本发明涉及一种纳米抗菌材料-聚砜复合微孔滤膜的制备方法，包括以下步骤：配制聚砜、溶剂、添加剂、纳米抗菌材料组成的混合铸膜液；静置脱泡，过滤除去杂质；用干/湿相转化法刮膜，浸入凝固浴中成膜；膜片在纯水中浸泡。采用本发明的方法制备的纳米抗菌材料-聚砜复合微孔滤膜，在膜过滤的同时，起到消毒杀菌作用，同时，防止膜面污染，可以更好地应用于生产制药用水和军事上“三防”条件下进行饮水净化的膜分离设备，它防止了膜面菌膜生长、控制产水的生物污染，达到提高产水质量的目的。

source_text: A detergent for removing heavy metals is a liquid detergent prepared by mixing fructus Sapindi Mukouossi extract, disodium Ethylene Diamine Tetraacetic Acid (EDTA), sodium dodecyl sulfate, water, polyvinyl alcohol and appropriate amount of perfume. Is transparent brown yellow, has no toxicity, and has no irritation or allergy to skin. The cleaning agent is used for cleaning the skin of workers who contact with heavy metals such as lead, manganese, cadmium, chromium and the like in mining, smelting and using industries (such as inspection and typesetting of printing factories and heavy metal smelting) and the like after class. target_text: 一种去重金属洗涤剂，由无患子提取液、乙二胺四醋酸二钠（ＥＤＴＡ）、十二烷基硫酸钠、水、聚乙烯醇和适量香料混合配制而成的一种液状洗涤剂。为透明的棕黄原色，无毒、对皮肤无刺激或过敏作用。用于接触铅、锰、镉、铬等重金属开采、冶炼及使用行业（如印刷厂的检、排字和从事重金属冶炼）的工人班后洗净皮肤上铅等重金属沾染。用本发明的洗涤剂洗手一分钟，对铅、镉、铬、锰、汞和砷等重金属沾染的洗脱率分别为９５．７５％、９１．１％、９４．８％、９９．６％、９０．６％和９９．３％。

source_text: The present invention provides a preparation method for natural biologic selenium and the application of products of the preparation method to medicine and health-care food. Wild edible sparssis crispa(wulf)Fr is used as a raw material and is prepared into selenium bacterium powder which can be widely used for medicine and health-care food containing organic selenium components. The method for preparing the selenium bacterium powder comprises: after being cleaned, fresh sparssis crispa(wulf)Fr is dried until the sparssis crispa(wulf)Fr can be pulverized; after being pulverized, the dried raw material is added to solvent for leaching, and after being soaked for certain time, the leaching solvent is filtered; obtained filter liquid is concentrated, baked and pulverized, which obtains soluble selenium bacterium powder; filter residues are baked and pulverized, which obtains non-soluble selenium bacterium powder.
target_text: 一种天然生物硒的制备及其制品在药品、保健食品中的应用，采用野生食用干巴菌为原料，制成硒菌粉，硒菌粉可广泛用于含有机硒成份的药品和保健食品；硒菌粉制备工艺为：鲜干巴菌经过清洗后进行干燥，干燥温度控制在20～70℃，干燥后的原料粉碎到40～80目后加入溶剂浸提，溶剂为水和助溶剂的混合物，助溶剂采用丙酮、乙酸乙酯、氯仿或乙醚有机溶剂，水与助溶剂的比例为5～20∶1，溶剂的加入量按固液比为1∶20～80，浸泡12～20小时后进行过滤，滤液经过浓缩、烘干和粉碎工艺后得到可溶性硒菌粉，滤渣经过烘干和粉碎工艺后得到不溶性硒菌粉。

source_text: The invention relates to a method for producing a monocrystalline component (1), having a complex moulded structure with different structure parts , from a molten metal. According to the method, said molten metal is located in a negative mould, corresponding to the moulding structure and said negative mould moves with the formation of a solidification front on a temperature drop, which is adapted to the crystallization speed of the molten metal and which includes the melting point. Said method is characterized in that at least one of the structure parts (2, 3) of the moulded structure experiences an individual temperature drop. If the solidification front has to grow through a structure part (2,3), which is inappropriately oriented in relation to the solidification front (7), said structure part (2,3) or zone can experience an individual temperature drop. This enables monocrystalline components (1), having a complex moulded structure, to be produced in a reliable and economical manner.

source_text: Disclosed is a resin-coated metal sheet which includes a resin film resulting from an emulsion composition containing an ethylene/unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer as a main component. source_text: Disclosed is a method and system for reducing the formation of metal catalyzed side-reaction byproducts formed in the feed vaporization and introduction system of a methanol to olefin reactor system by forming and/or coating one or more of the heating devices, feed lines or feed introduction nozzles of/with a material that is resistant to the formation of metal catalyzed side reaction byproducts.
